en.kicker: PhD applicant, entry 2027/28 · LLM post-training, alignment, evaluation
en.name: Kun Zhang
en.tagline: Post-training and alignment, on the attribution side: did the gain come from what was trained, or from something cheaper?
en.intro: MSc Advanced Computer Science, University of Leeds, 2025 to 2026. Five first-author papers accepted in 2026: NLPCC, PRICAI and ACML, all three oral, and two EMNLP workshop papers. Two more under review, both in Phase 2. Before I report a positive result, I run the control that would produce it for the wrong reason.

zh.tagline: 后训练与对齐的归因侧：一次增益来自训练的内容，还是来自更廉价的替代物？
zh.intro: 利兹大学高级计算机科学硕士，2025 至 2026。2026 年 5 篇第一作者论文录用：NLPCC、PRICAI 与 ACML（均口头报告），以及 EMNLP 研讨会两篇。另有 2 篇在投，均已进入第二阶段评审。在报告任何正结果之前，我先跑那个会因错误原因复现它的对照。
